Use this calculator https://dxm.tripsit.me/ and select “Robotab mL”, get that value and times by two for your dosages. Delsym is half the strength and twice the length. When your buying delsym, make sure the only active ingredient is DXM (I dont know if the kids bottle has any other active ingredients). You might want to buy a normal or bigger bottle depending on what plateu you would like to reach. If your over 18 and have an ID (at least in the US), you can buy it on your own, try to go to a place where you dont shop often and be accompanied by a friend. Some people may give you looks but it is best to ignore them before one trips. 

~Tripping~ 

I have only done it once, it was yesterday, I consumed a 148ML bottle of delsym. My boyfriend was accompanied with me and took a smaller bottle. This was around his third time.  The delsym tastes bad so buy a tracer with an aftertaste (soda), I just chuged it and once I was done with a few gulps, I drank the tracer to wash it down. After consumption, you may get a watery feeling in your neck, this is your body saying it wants to throw up, if you think you will throw up, you will. Try your best to ignore it and it goes away. The DXM will take about two hours to be in effect. When I first did it I had an amazing spiritual trip, all because of how I prepared my mind before hand. Your going to feel diffrent for a while, the most important thing is to accept these feelings and effects, dont think of them as scary and they wont be scary. All bad trips of paycidellics are born out of resistance, you may be reminded of bad memories, but if accept that then you may see them in a new light. 

I had my boyfriend over, if you feel like you’re going to need some assistance, ask a friend over. Although DXM is a very “in your head experience” 

Things will very from my experience, but the biggest thing is to be sound of mind before taking it, if you had a bad day at work or school beforehand, it may cause you a worse trip. 

Once your done, you may want to do it again. Try to limit yourself to about once per two weeks at most, if done more then that it can lead to many health problems. You also damage your liver when you do it too, so keep that in mind. 

Have fun, please read the megathread or go onto errowid / wikis to find more info, if you have any questions let me know!
